NOTICE AND CALL OF A SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF AZUSA
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF AZUSA:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, that a Special Meeting of the Planning Commission is hereby called to be held on THURSDAY, OCTOBER 24, 2024 at 7:00 p.m. at the Azusa Auditorium, located at 213 E. Foothill Blvd, Azusa, California 91702.
Said Special Meeting shall be for discussing, hearing and taking action on the items listed below:
AGENDA
NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC FOR REGULAR MEETING.

B)

C)

October 9, 2024

F)
CONTINUED ITEMS
1.
555 W. Danlee Street (UP-2024-02) ? The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider a Use Permit to allow for extended hours of operation from 5:00 AM to 9:00 PM for a construction contractor land use. The project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Guidelines Section 15301 (Class 1 ? Existing Facilities). Item was continued from the October 9th Planning Commission meeting.
2.
628 N. Pasadena Avenue (DR-2022-28, TTM-084449) ? The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider a Design Review to allow the construction of a 3-story, 6-unit condominium building with attached parking on a 7,700 square-foot lot and a Tentative Tract Map for the subdivision the existing parcel into six (6) air parcels. The project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Guidelines Section 15332 (Class 32 ? Infill Development). Item was continued from the October 9th Planning Commission meeting.
G)
PUBLIC HEARING
1.
204 W. Paramount St. (DR-2024-16, MUP-2024-08) ? The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider a Design Review and Minor Use Permit to allow for a proposed residential care facility at 204 w. Paramount St. The proposed business is an age restricted (55 years and over) assisted living facility for a maximum of 96 residents. The project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Guidelines Section 15301 (Class 1 ? Existing Facilities).

Development Code Amendment ? 2024 ADU and JADU Update ? The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider making a recommendation to the City Council for an amendment to the Development Code to comply with recent changes to state law that impose new limits on local authority to regulate Accessory Dwelling Units (?ADUs?) and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units (?JADUs?) and find that the amendment is statutorily exempt from CEQA under Section 21080.17 of the Public Resources Code.
